spec.title: Accounting Error (Very Bad)
spec.description:
This is an error where the custom_decimals configured in virtual OG is either too low or too high for the provided balance which is very, very bad. If this happens then positions could end up unhedged. In case of this metric ever being other than zero, an urgent investigation is required.

Please consult the `get_mimid_balance_and_decimal` function for more details.
